title: Agent Tools Registry
description: Universal registry of known AI coding agents and their standard directory conventions. Contains no local machine scan state.

schema_version.description: Schema version of this registry file.

updated_at.description: RFC 3339 (section 5.6) date-time timestamp when this registry was generated or updated.

sources.description: Upstream registry URLs used to compile this list.

total.description: Total number of agents in the agents array.

agents.description: Complete list of known AI agent tools.

key.description: Unique identifier key for the agent.

display_name.description: Human-readable display name of the agent.

detect_paths.description: Standard installation or config paths (using ~ for home) used to detect presence.

global_skills_dirs.description: Standard global skills directories; primary path first, alternatives/fallbacks after.

project_skills_dir.description: Project-relative skills directory path, or null if not applicable.

additional_scan_dirs.description: Additional directories (e.g. plugins/marketplace) scanned for skill discovery.

recursive_scan.description: Whether skills directory uses nested subdirectories requiring recursive SKILL.md discovery.

sources.description: Source identifiers where this agent definition originated.
